subject: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@fintechco.com>, Claire Thompson <claire@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing

Hi Daniel and Claire --

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps for the Mutual Action Plan (attached - redwood_MAP_draft_v3.pdf):

- Milestone: Load/performance test scheduling (Traffic replay + peak QPS simulation)
  - Target close for this milestone: 2026-07-22 (aligned to overall PO expected by end of month)
  - Responsibilities: FintechCo to provide PV traffic replay artifact + representative peak window; Redwood to run replay on a dedicated environment and deliver metrics report + sizing recommendation
  - Dependencies: replay dataset, test account credentials, expected SLA/latency targets, decision on dedicated capacity level

Proposed test window options (all PST):
- Option A: Tue 2026-07-20 09:00-12:00 (preferred - quieter infra window)
- Option B: Wed 2026-07-21 13:00-16:00

Initial sizing estimate (for planning): 4-6 x A100-80GB equivalent instances to reproduce ~1k peak QPS with typical request sizes (50-200 tokens). We'll validate once we have the replay sample.

Please confirm: 1) which test window you prefer, 2) who on your side will drop the replay artifact and how (S3 link, SCP, or upload to shared Drive), and 3) any guardrails (max runtime, data retention policy for the replay) we should follow.

Attaching: redwood_MAP_draft_v3.pdf (MAP draft) and load_test_runbook_v1.xlsx (our standard runbook).

Thanks - I'll coordinate engineers once we confirm timing.

--Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@fintechco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Claire Thompson <claire@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.b@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing

Thanks Rishi - big help. A couple quick answers:

1) Window: Option A on Tue 7/20 works for our infra team.
2) Replay artifact: we'll provide a sample S3 link for the peak 30-min window and a full-day tarball. I'll have Ethan upload the s3://fintechco-replays/finprod/2026-06-30/ folder and share credentials.
3) Guardrails: please purge any persistent logs within 7 days and do not retain PII - we'll anonymize the replay dataset before upload, but Redwood should confirm the deletion policy in writing.

Ethan - can you confirm you'll get the replay link by EOD Wed 7/14?

Also noted the 4-6 A100 guidance. If Redwood can provide an initial cost estimate for a 3-hour run and a short report template up-front, that would help our procurement team.

On the MAP target close: 7/22 is fine if the run completes and the sizing recommendation is delivered.

--Daniel
Daniel Wu
Head of Platform Engineering | FintechCo
Daniel.Wu@fintechco.com | +1 (212) 555-0189

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing

Thanks - looping in engineering to confirm run/infra details. Quick notes from Redwood infra side:

- Test prep checklist (we'll run through on Fri 7/16 if you'd like a 30-min runbook walk-through):
  1) Confirm S3 replay link + credentials (read-only temporary token preferred)
  2) Provide sample request schema and representative headers (auth/proxy behavior)
  3) Define peak QPS target (please confirm exact number - Daniel mentioned ~1k) and percentiles/latency SLOs to validate
  4) Confirm whether we should run with KV cache warm (recommended) or cold for worst-case latency
  5) Maximum run time and retention policy for logs/recordings

- Preliminary capacity ask: to reproduce 1k sustained QPS with median 100 token responses we plan to provision 5 x A100-80GB equivalents. If your traffic has many >512 token responses we'll re-evaluate (please indicate 95th pct response length).

- Cost estimate: approx $7-9k for a 3-hour dedicated run on 5 GPU nodes (includes runtime + ephemeral storage). We'll produce a line-item estimate in the MAP entry and in the final report.

We'll schedule the run for Tue 7/20 09:00-12:00 PST pending receipt of the S3 link and confirmation of the QPS target. If you want a runbook walkthrough before the test, propose Fri 7/16 10:00-10:30 PST.

Attachments: load_test_runbook_v1.xlsx (checklist + run commands).

--Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0444
From: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@fintechco.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing

All set from our side. Ethan uploaded the replay artifacts to S3 and shared a temp presigned link in the secure channel (see internal ticket). Key details:

- S3 sample (30-min peak window): https://s3.amazonaws.com/fintechco-replays/finprod/2026-06-30/peak_sample.tar.gz (presigned link shared separately)
- Full-day archive: s3://fintechco-replays/finprod/2026-06-30/full_day.tar.gz
- Confirmed peak target: 1,200 QPS sustained for 30 minutes (95th pct response length ~140 tokens)
- We require data deletion within 7 days and no persistent storage of raw payloads.

We confirm Tue 7/20 09:00-12:00 PST for the run. Please send any runbook/endpoint URLs and temporary test credentials by EOD Mon 7/19. If everything looks good, we'll mark the MAP milestone as complete once Redwood publishes the sizing report (target 7/22).

Thanks - see you on Fri if you want the runbook walkthrough.

--Daniel
